layout.footer: This is an automated message from Only One Coin. Please do not reply to this e-mail.

enrollment_received.subject: We received {studentName}'s enrollment
enrollment_received.preheader: We are verifying the payment for {courseName}.
paragraphs: We received {studentName}'s enrollment in {courseName}, with classes starting on {startsOn}.
We are verifying the payment of {amount}. We will write to you here as soon as it is confirmed.
The seat stays reserved while we review the payment.

payment_under_review.subject: We are reviewing {studentName}'s payment
payment_under_review.preheader: Our team will check the receipt for {courseName}.
paragraphs: The payment for {studentName}'s enrollment in {courseName} has gone to manual review.
Our team will check the receipt and write to you here with the outcome. There is no need to send it again.

payment_approved.subject: Enrollment confirmed in {courseName}!
paragraphs: We approved the payment for {studentName}'s enrollment in {courseName}. The enrollment is confirmed!
Classes start on {startsOn}.

payment_rejected.subject: We could not confirm {studentName}'s payment
payment_rejected.preheader: The receipt for {courseName} was not approved.
paragraphs: We could not confirm the payment for {studentName}'s enrollment in {courseName}, so the enrollment was not approved.
If you think this is a mistake, please reach out through Only One Coin's support channels.

portal_credentials.subject: Activate your Only One Coin student portal access
portal_credentials.preheader: Create your password to sign in.
paragraphs: Your enrollment was approved and your student portal account is ready.
Your username is {loginEmail}. You can also sign in with the document you enrolled with.
Use the button below to create your password. The link is valid for seven days and works only once.

portal_password_reset.subject: Reset your student portal password
portal_password_reset.preheader: The link is valid for one hour.
paragraphs: We received a request to reset the password of your Only One Coin student portal account.
Use the button below to create a new password. The link is valid for one hour and works only once.
If you didn't ask for this, ignore this e-mail: your password stays the same.

staff_password_reset.subject: Reset your Only One Coin panel password
staff_password_reset.preheader: The link is valid for one hour.
paragraphs: We received a request to reset the password of your Only One Coin panel account.
Use the button below to set a new password. The link is valid for one hour and can only be used once.
If you did not ask for this, ignore this e-mail: your password stays the same.

email_verification_code.subject: Your verification code: {code}
email_verification_code.preheader: Type it into the enrollment form. It expires in 10 minutes.
paragraphs: You are completing an enrollment at Only One Coin. To confirm this address is yours, type this code into the form:
{code}
The code expires in 10 minutes. If you are not enrolling, ignore this e-mail.

staff_mfa_code.subject: Your panel access code: {code}
staff_mfa_code.preheader: Type it into the Only One Coin panel. It expires in 10 minutes.
paragraphs: Someone who knows the password of your Only One Coin panel account is signing in or turning on two-step verification. To continue, type this code:
{code}
The code expires in 10 minutes and works only once. If this was not you, do not share it with anyone and change your password: without this code nobody gets into your account.
